name: Phenyltriethoxysilane
description: Phenyltriethoxysilane (CAS 780-69-8 ) is an organosilane monomer used to modify surfaces and build silicone-based polymer networks across multiple industrial sectors. It introduces phenyl functionality into silane chemistry, enabling improved thermal stability. This chemical allows for better compatibility with organic substrates and controlled crosslinking behavior in downstream formulations. In coatings and adhesives, it functions as a surface modifier and coupling agent for various materials. It improves adhesion between inorganic substrates, such as glass or metal, and organic resin systems. Formulators in the electronics industry incorporate it into encapsulants and dielectric coatings where phenyl-modified networks offer resistance. In plastics and polymer compounding, it acts as a crosslinking agent and compatibilizer, influencing mechanical performance. It also affects surface wetting in filled systems, making it a versatile component for industrial manufacturing. Personal care formulators use it as a building block for phenyl silicone emollients and film-forming agents. These deliver specific sensory and spreading properties in skin and hair products, enhancing the final consumer experience. Phenyltriethoxysilane is supplied as a clear liquid in standard packaging ranging from drums to IBC containers for bulk procurement. It is available in technical and high-purity grades for diverse needs. Purity specifications are typically at 97% or higher depending on application requirements.
